map.间接法计算经营现金流: Computing Operating Cash Flow by the Indirect Method
map.某公司净利润 200 万元，加回折旧摊销 80 万元，营运资本增加（应收、存货上: A company has net income of 200 (10k CNY) and adds back depreciation and amortisation of 80 (10k CNY); an increase in working capital (higher receivables and inventory, lower payables) ties up 50 (10k CNY), so operating cash flow = 200+80−50 = 230 (10k CNY).
map.为什么要加回折旧摊销？: Why add back depreciation and amortisation?
map.折旧摊销是非付现费用，已减少净利润但未流出现金，间接法需加回以还原为现金口径。: Depreciation and amortisation are non-cash expenses: they reduce net income without any cash outflow, so the indirect method adds them back to restore a cash basis.
map.营运资本增加为什么减现金？: Why does an increase in working capital reduce cash?
map.应收、存货增加或应付减少意味着现金被占用（先垫资后回款），故作为减项；反之释放现: Rising receivables or inventory, or falling payables, means cash is tied up (funding first, collecting later), so it is deducted; conversely, cash released is added back.
